onDevice: Read photos on this device only
toAi: The photo goes to the free AI service to be read, as it is: nothing on it is masked. This app doesn't keep it; the AI service's own terms apply to what it receives.
local: The photo is read on this device and never leaves it: only the text read from it is sent.
preparing: Getting the reader ready (the first time takes a little longer)…
offline: Scanning needs a connection. The photo wasn't kept.
cantOpen: That photo couldn't be opened. Try a JPEG or PNG.
checking: Checking how the photo can be read…
readerFailed: The reader on this device couldn't start. Try again in a moment.
